description_en: Moves a VPC peering connection to a different resource group
description_zh: 调用MoveResourceGroup接口修改对等连接所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun vpcpeer move-resource-group --resource-id pcc-gu32s92f9ytsk90000 --resource-type PeerConnection --new-resource-group-id rg-acfm3peow3k0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the peering connection instance
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改资源组的对等连接的实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to PeerConnection for a VPC peering connection
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值：PeerConnection，VPC对等连接
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the peering connection instance.

This feature lets you manage resources under your Alibaba Cloud account in groups. This simplifies tasks such as resource grouping and permission management within a single account. See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要移入对等连接实例的资源组ID。

资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region to which the resource belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain a region ID
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the resource group was changed. Valid values:

true: The resource group was changed.

false: The change failed
Success.description_zh:
是否修改成功。取值：

true：修改成功。
false：修改失败
